jobDescription:
Senior DevOps Engineer

You will own the platform that our sixty engineers deploy to.

Responsibilities:
- Operate and scale multi-cluster Kubernetes on AWS EKS
- Own infrastructure as code in Terraform across three environments
- Maintain service mesh configuration (Istio) and ingress policy
- Build and tune observability: Prometheus, Grafana, distributed tracing
- Lead incident response and run blameless postmortems
- Manage cost: reserved capacity planning, rightsizing, spot strategy

Requirements:
- 6+ years in infrastructure or platform engineering
- Deep Kubernetes knowledge, including CRDs and operators
- Production Terraform at scale
- Strong Linux and networking fundamentals
- On-call participation in a follow-the-sun rotation
